text: We had Borani Bademjan, Qabuli Palow, and Sultani kabab and all of them were great and flavorful. Staff was very friendly and helpful. We will definitely be back soon.

AVOID!

I can’t believe the high rating of this place. Their food was stale, service was terrible, we didn’t get some of items that we ordered. We had to go and fetch utensils and an extra chair ourselves bc the server didn’t bring even though we asked multiple times.

Terribly bad!! All the reviews are probably fake. We went there for dinner and the food was dated, definitely lunch leftover!
The service was horrible!! It couldn’t get worse. They ignored almost every request we had.

Do not go to this place
I think all the reviews are fake!
We came here on a Saturday night, ordered a couple of dishes
The service was so bad that we didn’t even get 3 of the dishes
The barg kebab was so hard that I am 100% sure it was left over from their lunch

The lamb chops are pretty delicious here on top of seasoned rice. They serve a side salad and bread with your meal. We also got the kubideh and steak and the steak was delicious but the kubideh was just okay.
We went for the lunch buffet and everything was delicious! Service exceptional, and ambience very conducive to the full experience of enjoying an extensive selection of freshly cooked Afghan cuisine.
Food is hearty. Atmosphere is homey.  Meat and rice yum.
The girl who serves inside is so sweet and sympathetic ❤️
It’s a hidden gem, highly recommended for catering.

The food was fantastic - so rich and flavorful! Portions were quite generous. Service was quick and friendly. So glad I stumbled across this little gem of a place when I was passing through Charlottesville!
Nice place with tasty Afghan food. We’ve tried the buffet option. It was tasty and filling :)

We were looking for a place as we passed through Charlottesville and ran into this one. What a magical spot! The food was fun and plentiful and the service was some of the best I've ever had! The kebabs are a little spicy for kids, but the vegetables, rice, and salad were incredible, and the chai and baklava were a perfect ending to the feast. I recommend getting one of the family style meals.
Fantastic place! Fantastic food! Live music on Friday night!
Very great food, and very nice people working☺️
Absolutely delicious, got dinner for two and everything tasted great. Recommend this place to all
Delicious food and friendly service! Would recommend
افغان کباب زندہ باد

Delicious meal here September 4. Chicken kebab with rice and side of chickpeas was very flavorful. Wife had vegetarian medley with chickpeas, potatoes, rice. Just great flavors all around. Server was very knowledgeable and helpful.

We visited on a Tuesday evening and the food was terrible. The kabob was ridiculously dry and the bread appallingly stale. I have worked in restaurants and I would be deeply embarrassed to send this out. My best guess is that they are serving left overs from the day or two before. Perhaps it is fresh food on the weekends and the fact that they served this bad food to customers says something about their character.

The Atmosphere is stark. Bright white LED lights with a flicker in the dining area. It was clinical and harsh.

I will never visit again and I will discourage all I know from visiting.

This place was fantastic! The lamb and chicken combo on rice absolutely floored me. The service and ambience on top of it made it a wonderful experience. Would easily recommend this spot to anyone looking for good Afghan food👍
This was good. Chicken was seasoned well and cooked well enough. It does not come with any sauces though, so that was slightly disappointing. But, food was good.
So delicious
We had a great time at afghan kabob house. We ate a lovely dinner of mantu, chicken samosas, and chicken kabobs. We wanted the bowlanee potato one, but they were out of it.
Great food good service coming from California

FOUND A METAL NAIL IN KABOB.

Got here during a road trip and tried to food. Unfortunately for us we bit the nail piece during our meal. The staff was not apologetic and did not even offer to refund the meal we had.

I have to check if I can have any options of legal action due to my experience here.
Lunch buffet on a Saturday, delicious, clean space, milk tea, peach iced tea, $20! What a deal. Eggplant and chickpeas were my fav 😋
Great lunch buffet, not a lot options, but very delicious
Had a fantastic dinner here! The kebabs were extremely well seasoned, and everything we tried was delicious. Would definitely recommend.

We received excellent service and hospitality on our first visit. Thank you for your food and the service! But the parking space was paid and limited, or maybe I didn’t know the area well😊. It looks like a family business, and I wish them continued success and better service.
Great food, we enjoyed trying the family combo got many options, will be coming back
I will recommend to go and visit this place sabzii was very delicious along with other food nice and friendly place really quiet environment

Gosh I detest writing negative reviews but this was an enormous mistake. Online there’s a lunch menu with kabobs. In the restaurant there’s a buffet. No kabobs. Can’t order from the menu. Chicken dishes were essentially bones with maybe a shred of meat in it. They were slow to refill the dishes. I did like the eggplant and chick peas. $40 for 2 people. Have no plan to ever return.

Food was fantastic, Raj was friendly and kind, art was great! Building is older and emptyish looking (probably because it was between lunch and dinner, on a Monday, during off season),  but in a lived in/ family kind of way. Which made it nicer inside

I was in town with my family and decided to try the buffet at this restaurant. It was one of the worst buffet experiences I’ve ever had. Nothing tasted fresh—it honestly seemed like the food had been sitting out for days. The quality was terrible, and it was a complete waste of money. I absolutely do not recommend this place, especially the buffet. Save your money and eat somewhere else.

I had a very disappointing experience at this restaurant. The food and the service were both far below expectations.

We ordered the chicken breast kebab, which was supposed to come with rice and naan. The naan was nothing like proper naan—it was dry and thin like a cracker, and the portion was extremely small. To make things worse, we were served our meal on tiny tea-saucer-sized plates, even though it was obvious the restaurant had regular dinner plates available. It made eating very inconvenient and felt unprofessional.

Overall, the portions, presentation, and service were disappointing. Unfortunately, I wouldn’t recommend this place based on my experience.
Excellent dishes, full of flavor and beautifully presented!

10 out of 10 would recommend! Great food, best of all it is a buffet style lunch, which means you can try everything to see what you like best. If you like your baklava not over sweet like I do, this was perfect! Packed with flavor. Check it out!!
Their kabobs and meat items were awesome along with other items. Meat was tender and cooked to perfection.
Great place for Afghan food!!
Best food and service
then most dry gyro meat ive ever had, ive eaten more tender jerky. it was also the smallest gyro ive ever seen. i used to go go here all the time and it wasnt this way. new owners?
Visited this wonderful place today , with friends and found it very relaxing and pleasant. We ate and enjoyed the food .

A friend and I found this place and decided to go on a whim. Best decision we ever made. The food is rich, complex and incredibly flavorful. We ordered the Vegetarian Samosa, Beef Manto Entree and I enjoyed the Qabuli Palow (lamb shank). The lamb was so tender it was falling off the bone. So delicious. And the man who took care of us, Raj - was attentive and clearly passionate about the food. 10/10 - Do yourself and eat there.

Great lunch buffet for $22 after taxes. Nice variety of veg and meat (chicken, goat) options.

Arrived at 1pm on a Friday and no other customers were present. 10 minutes later the restaurant was full (!).
Loved everything about it!
Great lunch buffet. Excellent variety and all well executed. Nice staff and very helpful with a large group.
This restaurant has the most authentic Afghan food I have had in years. The service was excellent as was the ambience.
Amazing customer service!

This restaurant is a great addition to the downtown mall area. They have amazing traditional Afghani food. Their friendly staff help you from the moment you walk in. The food you get is always fresh they serve enough to share so bring your appetite friends and family.
Incredible food

Everything on buffet was delicious. Lamb was tender and delicious. I could pretty much eat the spinach for all my meals every day for the rest of my life. Tandoori chicken moist, spicy, and delicious.

Amazing value and awesome food. Very good vegetarian variety. The lamb curry and chicken curry were my favorites. The chicken tandoori is very flavorful but a bit dry on the day I went. You can’t beat this amount of selection and protein. Also lunch buffet includes drinks. Would strongly recommend the milk tea even on a hot day.
Great Food & Great service
Delicious lunch! Love the eggplant, lamb, soup, and everything, really.
Wonderful lunch buffet! Everything was delicious and perfectly spiced
Delicious food, lovely service!
Delicious lunch buffet! Everything so flavorful and a really nice atmosphere.

So tasty! We happened upon the buffet, so got to try a good bit. Standouts for me were the qubali palow (sort of a rice pilaf), the chicken and lamb curries, and the frinee (creamy custard with rose & cardamom). I could eat that dessert every day! The staff are so friendly and helpful. Great stop for us while exploring Charlottesville :)
Loved it!

As a longtime fan of the Afghan kabob by JPJ stadium, I was pleasantly surprised to see a new location had opened by the mall. And the buffet is even better than I remember, the qabuli, chapli kabob and lamb curry especially stood out. For $20 this buffet is a steal, and the vibes are great in there as well.

We had meal for two people. The food was so delicious, I am Turkish and I am used to good food but this was exceptional. Don’t think twice.
The food felt like I am eating best Indian Middle Eastern mixed.
Everything was amazing. Thank you for delicious food 🙏🏻
Nice restaurant and nice people they serve delicious food and sweets!

So glad this place opened in downtown! The food is incredibly tasty and high-quality. I really like that they offer a dine-in option rather than just takeout. It was nice and quiet when we went, and the service we received was great.
Delicious food!!!
Dropped by on a Friday night and enjoyed a delicious chicken kebab and pleasant Jazz from the room over
Fantastic food and service on a Friday night dinner! Lovely jazz music and would highly recommend the lamb kebab.
incredible food & great service
Best place to be at the food is great. The customer service is great. I absolutely love it. That would prefer everybody to come and check this place out.
Yeah, everything’s good. I like it. The food underwear. Everything is good.
This is lovely new location in Cville.  Their food is amazing. The flavors are delicious and the portions are plentiful.
Delicious!
Yummy 😋

Really enjoyed this place. The room felt sweet and pleasant, and the whole atmosphere was relaxing. The food was delicious and the service was kind and attentive. A genuinely nice spot to sit, eat, and unwind.

I went to this fine establishment and was blessed with great food. I was given extra rice because they made a minor mistake in my order. They also didn’t have any ones, so they gave me a 5 as change. I give them a nice tip.
Had a full tandoori chicken dinner. Excellent salad soft bread, spicy chickpeas and a delicious rice tandoori chicken moist, flavorful, fell away from the bone.

I recently had lunch at Afghan Kebob House with my two young daughters. My girls absolutely loved the Chicken Kabobs with rice. I ordered the Chopan Kabob (lamb chops) and it was simply amazing! Before, we had tried the Appetizer Sampler and really enjoyed them all, especially the vegetarian Bolanee Gandana (samosas with leeks, cilantro, spices).

The atmosphere is lovely and the service was excellent. And I cannot say enough about the hospitality! Our server, Shaia, did an excellent job and was very friendly. The owner, Muhammad, who I have met before at the other location, treats you like an honored guest in his home. He brought us a free sampling of chicken and lamb curry which they had just prepared. And like everything else, it was wonderful!
Great food, better service
A must try place! Love the food 10/10

Authentic Afghani food.
Very flavourful and tasty.
I got the kabob combination #1 and it was delicious. The service was incredible as well
Incredible food and great service. I will be returning very soon’
Stumbled upon this place during a trip to UVA. We had the most wonderful meal, it felt like eating at someone’s home. So many great flavors and very reasonably priced. Please support this place.
Stopped in for lunch. Buffet only and selection was good and traditionally flavored

Had the buffet on Sunday and almost feel like I was stealing from them. It was such good food at such a reasonable price.

I'm excited I got Afghani food as well cuz I've had Indian a thousand times and it's okay but it's hard to find Afghani.
I ordered something else and they gave me something else! I ordered KabaliPulawo and they gave me Sumaso. I ordered three meals and all three were wrong.
Shaila was fantastic. She took excellent care of us and we left all 5 of the plates we ordered clean! Plus the Firnee was an amazing dessert! Thank you! A great spot for great value!
Very yummy food!
The entrees were very good and they came with really nice sides.. I liked the salad  and kebab
Amazing food! The buffet allows you to try all the different types of food.
Amazing food and service!
Excellent food perfectly prepared. There was even a small lounge type band for good background music. Worth it for sure
Excellent food with super flavorful spices.
OMG phenomenal tastes, I recommend going here, what a lovely gem.
Amazing food and atmosphere! We ordered several kabobs and the Aush soup, everything was delicious and we were very happy with the portion sizes. The live music was excellent!
It was delicious!

Wow, I had no idea this great food, people, place was here and SO GOOD!
Very reasonably priced!
I came in from the Tom Tom festival and the lunch buffet exceeded my expectations. Good food with a view into a culture I was unfamiliar with.
Delicious lunch buffet!
This place is dope.
Delicious and friendly. Will be back.
Excellent lunch buffet! Very reasonable parking nearby ($2 /hr).
Amaze, amaze, amaze
Very authentic food and atmosphere! Love the butternut squash and eggplant sides, combined with kebabs. We come at lunch too for the buffet.
Loved the Qabuli Palow and Sabzi Chalow! Both very delicious.  My kids kept eating the leek dumplings and chicken tandoori.  Service was great, nice atmosphere.
Very good food and great service highly recommended!
Food was very tasty
We have been with the friend during lunch time (buffet). The food was delicious! Very nice atmosphere as well. Very cozy place with a lot of interesting paintings and souvenirs.

I came for the Lunch Buffet. The food is good and they have a moderate selection of meats, as well as a couple v/options. They have a great selection of appetizers for a healthy meal with fresh cut fruit.

The atmosphere is calm and relaxing; the staff are super nice and hospitable.

Definitely a nice visit, I’ll be enjoying that lunch buffet often.

The food was delicious and fresh. The customer service was excellentstaff were very friendly, respectful, and attentive. The place was clean and well-organized, and the atmosphere was comfortable and welcoming. Everything was handled professionally, and I really enjoyed my experience here. I would definitely recommend this place to others and will be coming back again.
Very good food I love it
What a wonderful fresh fruit juice!
The food was absolutely delicious just as good as the customer service this is a great place for a lunch buffet with family or by your self definitely recommended this place to anyone visiting
Very good
We enjoyed a buffet where the food exceeded expectations for a typical spread.

Great food. Shaila was so kind!
We will be back!
Great food.  Sheila was great too.
Phenomenal.
Delicious! Great food and great service
Great food and atmosphere near the downtown mall!
Great food, great service
Amazing place for Afghan food in town - their shrimp skewers were kickass ❤️❤️ would visit again!
Food was excellent
The food was delicious especially the Kabali pulao and the chicken boti I had. Aesthetic ambience with afghan cultural paintings. Would definitely recommend.

Fantastic restaurant. That food was delicious beyond belief, and the service was excellent.  We ordered the complete dinner for 4 and we had our fill, and have enough for another complete meal. I could not recommend this restaurant strong enough.

Relaxed, comfortable, cozy vibes.

Food cooked to perfection. Try the Kabuli Pulao.

Now open and operating this Afghan Kabob House is a fantastic new addition near the University of Virginia. The food is authentic, fresh, and full of flavor, truly representing Afghan tradition. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, with a family-friendly environment that makes you feel at home.

The service is excellent, respectful, attentive, and genuinely kind. Whether you’re dining in or ordering takeout, the experience is consistently great. A special thanks to the owner Mr Mohammad for his hospitality and dedication. Definitely worth visiting and supporting this new local business! #UVA

what an amazing Afghan kebab place has just opened in downtown Charlottesville. The service is on spot, friendly and positive atmosphere. You will get to see old Afghan rugs fashion, and you will enjoy the best of Afghan kebab and Afghan food.
I visited this morning. Here is some awesome pictures you guys can see for yourself.

We had a lunch buffet. Everything was fresh a lot veg option.
The prices were good and great customer service I hire recommend this place will come back.
Plenty of food for the price and absolutely delicious
Excellent service, and great food!
Very good food and service
Food is very good
Wow !! Best food in town , not expensive at all , greatly recommend!!😋😋😋
Really good chicken tandoori kabob!
Amazing service, atmosphere and value for money.
We tried their buffet lunch. It was decent. The service and ambience was nice and appreciative.
Great buffet and Great ambience!
Great experience. Food was good. Service was great
Came in for brunch. Everyone was welcoming, and the food was fresh, varied, and fantastic. A welcome addition to downtown!
Everything tasted great! Service was great too!
Very good food
The service was okay the lady was good. The place was kinda dirty. The food while having good flavor felt old and came with wayyyyy too much rice. We came after the buffet
Delicious!

I love the atmosphere here. They never have the music too loud and they're always very respectful.

The main server Sahar is always so nice. Helps that she always smiles at me. She is very quick to clean and weighed dirty plates and make sure you have enough to drink while you're eating.

And the food is always good.
Very authentic Afgan recipes and culinary preparations. Excellent vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. Highly recommended!
The staff were the absolute sweetest! Great food, great people, great experience! We will be coming back soon!
The food was amazing! It was so full of flavor and fresh. The waitress was also super sweet and very attentive. My family and I really enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back again.
Amazing host ,very generous amount of food and they gave us extra salads ,tea and deserts.

The Downtown Mall has a lot of great food, and this might be the best! At least, it’s the only place I’ve wanted to go again, and again, and again for the last few months. The veggies are amazing, the gyro wrap is probably the best gyro I’ve ever had… I could go on and on. Bottom line is it’s super delicious, and the people who run it are truly kind people.

Shaila was very kind and the food was excellent! The chicken and steak were full of flavor and the portions are generous and filling. This is a unique experience full of culture and good food! You won’t be disappointed!
Authentic afghani food - liked the kababs, chicken curry and the milk tea !
Amazing so good and lovely
Delicious lunch buffet for $17 with lots of options! Outstanding service as well with a really homey atmosphere. Will definitely be back.

This was our first time at this restaurant and we’re highly impressed. We had never been to the other location either. Food flavors were wonderful with generous portion size and great price in this age. Comfortable atmosphere and very pleasant and friendly staff. Super nice to the owner come to table to ask about the food and have a conversation. Highly recommend and we will be back.
Went back for lunch buffet. I am not a big buffet person but this was the bomb if you want to try various things which I did! Highly recommend the lunch buffet.
Left no leftovers it was that good! :) genuinely some of the best afghan food we’ve had in a while.
The food was delicious combined with the live music the whole experience was excellent! The service was wonderful, the lady we had was very friendly and kind. Will be dining again!

My wife and I got the dinner for 2 which felt very adventurous and fun as each course came to our table. And everything was delicious. We were there during a piano trio which made the warm vibe even better. Our waitress was fantastic.
I like that beautiful dinner. It truly refreshed the taste of my country's food and reminded me of my homeland. Thanks

Lunch buffet was delicious and well priced!
20$ with tip for 2 full plates of food! The lamb curry and spinach were both very good

Stopped in for the buffet lunch today and was blown away. Such a cozy little spot on the outskirts of the downtown mall. So stoked to find this place now that I am trying to eat more vegan/vegetarian options. The eggplant is freaking fantastic, especially when topped with the mixed salads, yogurt, and chili sauce. I paired it all up with the chickpeas and the rice. Make sure you get some milk tea and request some flatbread. Put this spot on your lunch rotation ASAP!
Food was really delicious and good service

This was our first trip to the restaurant and it's pretty likely I will go back eventually.  The salad and main course (chicken kabobs) were good and while I wasn't sure what spice level to expect it was extremely mild yet pleasant with a healthy dose of Saffron and Turmeric.  I tried the Doogh drink, it was too bitter for my preferences.  Notably there were several items we attempted to order, but they were not available (and the main reason for my 3 stars on the service because the waitress did a fine job).  We also ordered an eggplant appetizer which tasted good to my son and me, but was not popular with most of my family.
The food is delicious, great ambience and amazing customer service. Highly recommend it!
So wonderful!! Highly recommend
We loved the food and atmosphere. It’s authentic and also amazing service

My family and I very much enjoyed our meal here. The server was very nice and helped us pick the best options. All the meat was very well seasoned and the rice was cooked to perfection. I would come here every day!Definitely the best Afghan restaurant ever!
A nice assortment of delicious food on the buffet. It was reasonably priced and the service was great. I highly recommend.
Excellent, service, food, drinks, price, and really clean.

I had never had Afghani food until I came here and wow it was amazing🥹
I wish I sat in instead of taken it to go because it was a wonderful atmosphere, I'll be back! Wonderful service and insight, very helpful staff. You can grab from the food bar or order something right from the fire! The chicken kabob dish with rice is seasoned perfectly and they gave me some special chickpeas with a delicious sweet marinade (I provided photos) !!!! 15 minutes free parking nearby and paid parking right in front of the restaurant not sure how much it costs. Food only costed me $20 and they are generous with portion and pack the to go box good for you so it doesn't make a mess in your car. It was so good, the tastes were truly to savor. I had to call up the restaurant just to say how thankful I was🫵❤️
yummy food and attentive service! we enjoyed the beef samosa, chopan kabob skewer, and chicken kabob skewer.
Delicious shrimp and chicken tandoori kabob and samosas. Just what we needed for a late night dinner!
Amazing
Great experience!! Shalia was a great waitress!! Very helpful and nice!
Best buffet in town (by far)!
I had a lunch buffet. Everything is fresh. Customer service is great.

MUCH MORE THEN KABOBs!

Fantastic menu. Good food at affordable pricing. One block from Charlottesville pedestrian Mall -- convenient yet of the beaten track

New place, not yet widely discovered. Plenty of seating too.

Tip: Perfect for groups and family too, as Afghan Kabob offers several multi-person platters and meals. And they can seat groups.

My only suggestion would be to grill the lamb a bitt less and boil the beef dumplings a bit less.

Recommend!

Came up to visit Charlottesville and saw that there was an afghan buffet. Was not at all disappointed - very delicious! My favorites were the lamb curry, the qabuli, the eggplant, and the rice pudding. Also would highly recommend their milk tea!
Delicious food and a very friendly experience.  The dumplings were very flavorful and the vegetarian options so tasty.  Will be back!
The environment here is very distinctive and the food is excellent. Thank you for your service. It's very friendly. I like here!
Delicious food and attentive service. We got the dinner for 2 and it easily fed 3 of us (2 adults and 1 tween).
Food was delicious.
Delicious

My son and I came here for the first time to taste Afghan cuisine. The lunch buffet was very sumptuous, and all the food was delicious and fresh! The fried rice, mutton and hot drinks are amazing! Thank you for your warm service! We will come again and introduce it to more people!
Food was absolutely delicious! Very nice atmosphere & great service.
We had a wonderful meal after the indie shorts film festival
The food was excellent and the service was great as well. The food was very fresh and prepared to order.

This place is AMAZING. The food is delicious and so authentic here. If you have a low spice tolerance, the food here contains a medium amount if spice but is full of flavor. Service was great and our host was extremely nice.
Excellent food! Authentic ,with the right amount of spices! Great ambience and service! The host was very gracious! A dining experience worth the visit!
We had the Saturday lunch buffet. Exceptionally flavorful cuisine. From chicken kabobs, chicken curry, lamb currry. Spinach curry were all exquisitely flavorful. The bread too was great.

I ordered the vegetable samosas and a salad, both of which were very tasty! The salad is generous and flavorful. I also had a chickpea dish that was delicious. Friendly staff and fun jazz music on a Friday night.
Had a great meal here - from salad to the main to dessert and tea we really enjoyed it.
I was very excited to come here and had the combo 4–it was so delicious! Definitely a new favorite spot.
The best food I’ve ever had!!! Great quality, affordable and excellent service!!! Loved it!
Excellent food and service! The portions are generous and the chicken tandoori kebabs were excellent!

I
had a great experience. The lady was extremely kind, patient, and very helpful. She went above and beyond to make sure everything was taken care of. Excellent customer service!
Incredible food - everything was so good and my only wish is that I had capacity to have a third plate!  Armani was our server and was super friendly and fun to talk with.
Excellent food service. They are now serving beer as well. Highly recommend the chicken breast kebab and the chai!
Very friendly Service, also was fresh and flavorful.
Wow!! The food and service was amazing! Everything was delicious and so much flavor! Definitely try the milk tea! Can't wait to come back with my family!
Delicious food! Spiced amazingly and clearly made from scratch. Plentiful complex vegetarian options too. Will definitely be coming here again soon.
Food is beyond fantastic. Exotic traditional food. Loved it.
Superb experience, come here! You get so much bang for your buck it's wild!
Delicious and wonderful environment! Our server was also really great, will be coming back for the lunch buffet c:
Potatoes and spinach were awesome
The chicken was very tender and flavorful.  Our waitress was very kind and the restaurant was very cozy and welcoming!
Very nice atmosphere and wonderful food and service! Definitely recommend!
Great food in a favorite old location downtown. 10/10  would eat here again!
Food was absolutely delicious

I’ve been lucky enough in the cities I’ve lived in to be able to eat Afghan food on a regular basis. It’s a wonderful cuisine. They do magical things with cinnamon and pumpkin that I’d never think would taste as good as they do. The Kebab house in Charlottesville nails it. Had the Aushak (leek dumplings), and a kebab combo. Flavor was spot on, portions were generous, and service was attentive and kind.

Not from the area but will be back when I’m here next!
Perfect food with high quality 😍 service is really good and nice with Sheila
Beautiful music and food. Great service.
Great food and better service! I highly recommend the signature dish, Kabuli Pulao.
We had the Saturday buffet and it was unbelievable! Will definitely be back. Some of the best food I’ve had in cville in the 6 years I’ve lived here.
Best afghan food ever.  One of the best restaurants in Cville.  Added bonus of music on a Friday night.  We will be back.
Wow, wow, wow!!!  The food is absolutely incredible!!!  Every single thing we had was delicious.  The service was fabulous.  We can’t wait to come back.  Thank you!!
Amazing
Fantastic foos, service
EXCELLENT food, great, kind service. We were very impressed. Would love to come back. Highly recommend!
The buffet food was amazing. So was the local music. Would definitely come again!!!

Everything about Afghan Kebob House is amazing! The service was great and the staff is so kind! The food is incredible, some of the best middle eastern food we have had. We got the appetizer sampler, kebab combo #3, and the shrimp kebab. Highly recommend!
Incredible food! I’m celiac and got the chicken kabab. It was so delicious and didn’t get glutened! Service was really friendly. Atmosphere was really nice.
The lamb kebab wrap was soooo good! A must try!
Excellent food, fast service, clean, and convenient.  Prices and portions are great.  Thanks!

We had a fantastic evening at Afghan Kebob in downtown Charlottesville.  Amazing food, including nice vegetarian options.  Super friendly staff and lovely live light jazz c/o The Bob Bennetta trio, who play there every Friday evening 6:30-8:30p
The food is terrific (I especially like the chicken kofta), the staff is very friendly, the atmosphere is pleasant. Really a great place. Highly recommend!

The rice was incredible great portions and the rest of the food great. We had a full dinner left over after that as we ordered the eight person dinner. Overall it was a great experience and I recommend trying it.
The food is excellent! The service is extraordinary. Such an incredibly beautiful place!
